text: Biotechnology is an interdisciplinary field that integrates biology, chemistry, engineering and other disciplines. It aims to modify and utilize living organisms or biological systems through modern scientific and technological means (such as genetic engineering, cell engineering, fermentation engineering, etc.) to solve practical problems in fields such as medicine, agriculture, environment and energy. As an undergraduate major, it belongs to the category of biological sciences, with a duration of four years and confers a Bachelor of Science degree. This major emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, focusing not only on the study of basic biological theories but also on the cultivation of the application and development capabilities of biotechnology.
